recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If the current API Incubator GraphDefinition source needs a fresh audit or edit for reverse lookup examples or wildcard path semantics, handle that in the API Incubator work stream rather than in this core repository.
issue_request: FHIR-13352 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked for GraphDefinition to support resources that reference the current resource, analogous to _revinclude. The accepted resolution was to add an example and allow wildcard (*) for path while still allowing compartment limits on wildcard traversal.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 13078, represented by git commit a13eab28132c3e5d1f02995964aac46716c39b81, which added GraphDefinition documentation examples for wildcard traversal and reverse lookup using a missing path plus params. Later GraphDefinition rewrites, including FHIR-25474, retained the capability as GraphDefinition.link.path reverse/wildcard semantics and GraphDefinition.link.params criteria.
additional_context: The current core checkout no longer owns or builds GraphDefinition. source/fhir.ini has no active GraphDefinition entries, source/graphdefinition was removed by the R6 normative changes commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd, and current core narrative points GraphDefinition readers to the API Incubator. FHIR-22785 was found as same-artifact background for the _graph search result parameter, but it is a separate R5 search capability issue and was not decided.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The seed request was already applied while GraphDefinition lived in core, and any current GraphDefinition semantic correction would belong outside this FHIR core checkout/current build.

related_jiras.note: Same GraphDefinition family, but it concerns the separate _graph search result parameter and was not audited as an additional decision.
